scope: Static code and contract review plus four existing release workloads; no product behavior changes.

notes: Direct invocation of an existing optimized benchmark; no compilation, full test suite, containers or real network.
Temporary generated libraries only; no personal library inspection.
Absolute local operation means, not before/after gains, p99 or physical terminal latency.
Fixture setup precedes operation timers. Server probes measure local storage only, not HTTP latency.

findings.title: Cancel active obsolete read projections
findings.confirmed_observation: Latest skips obsolete queued inputs and discards old results, but operation(job.input) runs to completion once admitted. Catalog/navigation SQL and layout preparation have no operation-scoped generation token.
findings.proposed_improvement: Pass cooperative cancellation into replaceable reads/layouts; consider connection-owned interruption for active read SQL. Keep durable personal writes on their separate ordered lane.
findings.validation: Rapidly replace a deliberately slow search or resize; verify newest-result latency, reduced completed obsolete work, WAL consistency and preservation of every committed write.

findings.title: Separate page totals from page retrieval and evaluate seek pagination
findings.confirmed_observation: read_page executes an exact count for every request. Newest-first page identities use LIMIT/OFFSET, so deep browsing still skips earlier matches.
findings.proposed_improvement: Cache totals by complete predicate and database revision, with expiry for time-dependent filters. Prototype keyset cursors for sequential navigation while retaining exact arbitrary jumps and search relevance semantics.
findings.validation: Compare first/deep pages at 10k/100k/1m rows with identical results, timestamp ties, concurrent refreshes, retained Inbox selections, grouped views, Boolean FTS and both directions.

findings.title: Retarget image CPU preparation before encoding obsolete crops
findings.confirmed_observation: Image rendering captures the request key before decoder.fit, then checks only whether the request still exists before preparing pixels. A different crop for the same URL can remain active while the old crop is encoded and later discarded.
findings.proposed_improvement: Recheck exact keys between fit and encoding; reuse already loaded bytes for the latest crop. Add cancellation checkpoints to bounded Sixel bands where useful, preserving the existing HTTP cancellation.
findings.validation: Open an inspector during inline preparation and pan/zoom rapidly; count obsolete encodes, disk reads and HTTP calls, verify final pixels and ensure closing stops admission.

findings.title: Isolate remote discovery and evaluate server-wide delta collection
findings.confirmed_observation: sync_servers discovers enabled servers sequentially. Scheduler refresh waits for all discovery before collecting publisher feeds. Entry collection requests /v1/feeds/{id}/entries separately for each remote feed.
findings.proposed_improvement: Use bounded independent discovery with a serialized guarded publication lane, so a slow connection does not delay unrelated feeds. Separately investigate a supported server-wide delta/batch API and its cursor contract before replacing per-feed requests.
findings.validation: Use delayed/failing servers and unrelated local HTTP sources; measure first-source completion and request counts, respecting Retry-After, connection changes, tombstones and resumed history cursors.

findings.title: Account for every retained image allocation
findings.confirmed_observation: ReaderImages enforces 32 MiB using SixelRows bytes only. Thumbnail cell buffers and native Protocol payloads are outside that byte sum, although entry count and inspector-crop limits still bound retention.
findings.proposed_improvement: Add unified retained-byte accounting for row payloads, native data and buffers; expose a bounded memory preference with sensible defaults. Include active decoder/fit allocations in peak-RSS qualification.
findings.validation: Exercise blocks/Sixel/iTerm2, 32 formula slots, two inspector crops and eviction; verify bounded retained bytes and RSS without requeue loops or eviction of needed visible rows.

findings.title: Reduce image source rereads and fitting lock contention
findings.confirmed_observation: A prepared-key cache miss rereads original bytes from disk. Decoder reuse is digest-based, and crop/resize or SVG render still occurs while holding the shared decoder mutex; encoding is already outside it.
findings.proposed_improvement: Evaluate a small immutable original-byte cache and checkout of decoded source handles before expensive fitting. Bound retained and in-flight memory together, and preserve offline-original authority and file revision correctness.
findings.validation: Measure repeated uncached pans on large JPEG/SVG sources, disk-read bytes, digest work and two-lane wait time; verify replaced files, offline release and peak memory.

findings.title: Share immutable prepared layouts instead of cloning entire projections
findings.confirmed_observation: Rendered owns vectors of lines/mappings and a String. Layout cache hits return ready.rendered.clone(), cloning these owned fields rather than only a shared snapshot handle.
findings.proposed_improvement: Prototype immutable shared base projections with source-bound mutable selection/annotation overlays. Prioritize large documents only: the current cached-layout probe is already fast.
findings.validation: Use recent-layout workloads plus dense annotations and resize; compare allocations, RSS and navigation latency while preserving source ranges and avoiding styles or personal marks crossing articles.

findings.title: Optimize residual ordinary counts only after measuring larger libraries
findings.confirmed_observation: Selective invalidation and sharing of identical smart filters already exist. The remaining ordinary total query scans articles, and grouped destination counts scan all feeds/servers/collections when requested.
findings.proposed_improvement: Evaluate incremental ordinary counters or a revision-keyed totals cache for very large collections. Keep distinct complex smart-list counts selective and preserve external-write invalidation.
findings.validation: Benchmark mutation bursts at 100k+ rows and compare every cached count to authoritative queries after refreshes, undo, bulk edits and concurrent connections.

findings.title: Make expensive storage diagnostics cancellable and independently scheduled
findings.confirmed_observation: Storage and StorageDetails share the single-admission maintenance lane with backups, offline preparation and retention. Diagnostics do not receive the cancellation token; details aggregate source bodies, dbstat and FTS content.
findings.proposed_improvement: Separate read-only diagnostics from durable maintenance admission, add cooperative/SQL cancellation and progress, and expose clear busy-operation ownership. Keep destructive maintenance serialized.
findings.validation: Start a slow storage scan during a backup/offline job, cancel or close it, and verify reading remains responsive, reports have a coherent snapshot and cleanup cannot be reordered.

findings.title: Measure FTS duplication before redesigning disk storage
findings.confirmed_observation: article_search_content retains body text in addition to article/document storage. Existing storage details already expose those copies and SQLite object allocation. Compression remains a proposal.
findings.proposed_improvement: Collect actual per-table/source sizes, then compare external-content FTS and optional backup/SVG compression separately. Review dependencies and preserve legacy formats before adding a codec.
findings.validation: Verify exact search/ranking/snippets, updates/deletes, restore and retention; measure disk bytes, decode latency, RSS and cold/warm startup. Do not infer a codec win from its design.

findings.title: Make ordinary image cache policy less write-heavy and more adaptable
findings.confirmed_observation: Every ordinary image cache write enumerates and sorts cache files. Eviction uses modification time; reads do not refresh recency. The limits are fixed at 64 MiB and 128 files.
findings.proposed_improvement: Compare amortized pruning or a bounded manifest and explicit age/recency policies; expose useful byte/count settings. Preserve no-follow ownership checks, cross-process safety and pinned-cache separation.
findings.validation: Measure a gallery download burst and repeated access to old images; verify limits, concurrent writers, foreign files, symlinks and retention interaction.

findings.title: Offer explicit optional bidirectional Miniflux state sync
findings.confirmed_observation: The documented contract imports read/starred flags only on first observation. Later local edits stay local; this is deliberate mirror behavior, not a broken current contract.
findings.proposed_improvement: Keep mirror mode as the default. Add an explicit opt-in read/starred sync mode with a durable outbox, idempotent retries and conflict policy, plus clear local/remote status and source-specific refresh controls.
findings.validation: Never write remotely without opt-in; test offline edits, restarts, repeated deliveries, remote conflicts, token changes and preservation of local notes.

findings.title: Support named offline packages and reconcile pinned assets
findings.confirmed_observation: One offline_package settings value owns the latest checkpoint. New preparation replaces it while reusing the shared pinned directory. Old files count toward its 512 MiB/4096-file limit until explicit release.
findings.proposed_improvement: Add a package manager with named captures, per-package status/budgets and reference-counted shared assets. Define replacement/release semantics and preview stale pins before reclaiming them.

evidence.match: Pinned cache limit reached; release the old package first

findings.validation: Prepare overlapping and disjoint packages; verify cancel/resume, retention protection, shared image ownership, restore and byte accounting without deleting assets needed by another capture.

findings.title: Bring linked pages closer to the main Reader
findings.confirmed_observation: WebPage.prepare replaces images with text links and uses options.text_only(), so temporary linked pages lack the main Reader image/formula presentation.
findings.proposed_improvement: Reuse bounded Reader presentation for linked pages and allow explicit save/offline capture, preserving article identity, back/forward history and local annotations.

evidence.match: They are text views with explicit image links;

findings.validation: Test back/forward, fragment jumps, source offsets, images, formulas, cancellation and return to the original article without marking it read or moving its notes.

findings.title: Handle larger galleries and repeated formulas on demand
findings.confirmed_observation: Reader admission caps ordinary and graphical formula slots at 32 each. Formula conversion caches live in each document Builder, so repeated formulas across reflows/documents are not shared by that semantic cache.
findings.proposed_improvement: Explore viewport-based slot admission and a bounded shared semantic/vector formula cache; provide fallback reasons for unsupported syntax versus resource limits. Keep per-expression/document admission limits.
findings.validation: Use long galleries and formula-heavy papers; verify stable scrolling, limits, readable fallbacks, selections, budget charging on cache hits and exact source anchors.

findings.title: Choose responsive image variants for actual viewport and inspection
findings.confirmed_observation: HTML normalization chooses the highest accepted srcset candidate and emits one Markdown URL, discarding alternatives before viewport size is known.
findings.proposed_improvement: Preserve bounded picture/source/srcset metadata and select a supported variant for thumbnail versus inspector demand. Define explicit original/high-resolution access and recoverable lower-variant fallback.
findings.validation: Compare downloaded bytes and readable fine detail across card/inspector widths, density descriptors, picture sources, unsupported formats, broken candidates and source revision changes.

findings.title: Provide an interactive retention review and consistent protection explanations
findings.confirmed_observation: Retention preview returns totals and explain inspects one ID. Automatic retention evaluates smart-list protection; manual Full cleanup uses base personal protections, a documented narrower set.
findings.proposed_improvement: Add a paginated eligible/protected browser with effective source policy and reasons. Make the manual-versus-automatic distinction explicit, or deliberately unify policy after reviewing the contract.
findings.validation: Compare preview rows with actual candidates, including smart exceptions, favorites, folders, active readers and concurrent edits; no inspection may acknowledge or activate cleanup.

findings.title: Extend backup recovery UX and capacity controls
findings.confirmed_observation: TUI backup commands expose status/now/cancel. Bundle verification and isolated restore already exist as library APIs; CLI restore is also present. Rotation is count-based, and SQLite copying has a fixed 30-second deadline.
findings.proposed_improvement: Expose bundle browsing/verification and safe restore guidance in the TUI, add optional byte/age rotation limits and progress/time-budget configuration. Qualify compression for cold backups separately.
findings.validation: Use large databases and slow storage, low disk space, interrupted copies, checksums and failed rotation. Preserve no-overwrite restore and existing complete bundles.

findings.title: Add live preview to existing smart-list editing and configurable article ordering
findings.confirmed_observation: A smart-list editing form already exists, but save_smart commits its filter directly. Normal pagination uses published/id descending; ArticleQuery has no user sort selector.
findings.proposed_improvement: Extend the existing form with cancellable preview/count and query examples, and add typed sort options per view or list. Keep recommendation/relevance ordering explicit.
findings.validation: Check preview/save agreement, invalid Boolean input, changing counts, stable ties, selection preservation, revision-aware caches and sort-safe pagination.

findings.title: Extend existing local performance diagnostics with job ownership
findings.confirmed_observation: :performance already exposes bounded processing samples and p50/p95/p99/max. Its operation categories do not separately identify SQL, HTTP, fit/encoding, cache hits or wasted canceled work.
findings.proposed_improvement: Add an opt-in activity view with current source/job/phase, queue age, cache counters, cancellation/obsolete-work counts and scoped timings. Keep collection local and bounded.
findings.validation: Verify disabled diagnostics add no timing/allocations, secrets stay redacted, memory is bounded, and processing timestamps are not presented as physical display latency.

findings.title: Correct responsive-image limits in key bindings
findings.confirmed_observation: The key-bindings guide said 2560 pixels/3x, while code and native fixtures accept 4096 pixels/4x.
findings.proposed_improvement: Update the guide to the implemented bounds; no functional change.
findings.validation: Check the published guide against the implementation and existing fixture; no build or behavior-test rerun is needed for the numeric documentation correction.

findings.title: Make default graphical formula foreground follow the selected theme
findings.confirmed_observation: The vector renderer sets default glyph color to RGB(224,219,208). Nord/Gruvbox remap UI text colors, but prepared image pixels intentionally bypass that text remapping.
findings.proposed_improvement: Pass the theme default foreground into formula generation and its cache identity, preserving explicitly colored TeX and publisher image colors.
findings.validation: Switch among supported themes with cached formulas; verify glyph foreground, background, cache invalidation, explicit formula colors and unchanged source mappings.

documentation: Corrected key-bindings responsive-image limits to 4096 pixels / 4x.
